title: The Pinata Free-For-All! II
description: The Pinata Free-For-All! II — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: QuestGiver_B

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Destroy the Pinata and Slay 15 Grunt Gladiators in the Pinata Free-For-All off of Level 2 of Ratsputins Gulag and return to the Excited Lad in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: QuestGiver_B

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Destroy the Pinata and Slay 15 Grunt Gladiators in the Pinata Free-For-All off of Level 2 of Ratsputins Gulag and return to the Excited Lad in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

You are doing great, but it is time to step up your game. If you want to really leave a mark on the Pinata Invitational you need to do more then just whack the pinata, you need to take down some of the other contenders too!

First, go to the entrance to the Pinata Invitational off of Level 2 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Then destroy the Pinata while at the same time slaying 15 Grunt Gladiators. If you don't get them on your first try you should try again until you have them all. When you are done return to me, the Excited Lad, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

You did it! Keep it up and you will go down as a legend of the Pinata Invitational! If you want to try it again just talk to me.

Objectives:

  • Destroy the Pinata
  • Slay Grunt Gladiators

Client level range: 80–100
